facts: An edge points from each prerequisite to its dependent.
Lexicographic selection makes ready-node choices deterministic.
fact_paraphrases: Edges run from prerequisites to dependents.
Each dependency edge is directed from a prerequisite to its dependent.
A node depending on itself forms a cycle.
Choosing the lexicographically smallest ready node makes scheduling deterministic.
Selecting ready nodes in lexicographic order yields deterministic choices.
